summary: How an entity looks and interacts with light. `Emissive` makes it a light source; `Albedo` decides how much light it blocks and what color the light takes when passing through.
summaryText: How an entity looks and interacts with light. Emissive makes it a light source; Albedo decides how much light it blocks and what color the light takes when passing through.
examples:
The following example shows a light, a solid wall and a pane of red glass:

```csharp
ECS.AddComponent<Material>(lamp).Emissive = new Color(255, 200, 120);       // Alpha sets brightness
ECS.AddComponent<Material>(wall).Albedo = Color.Black;                      // Blocks all light
ECS.AddComponent<Material>(glass).Albedo = new Color(255, 60, 60, 160);   // Tints light red
```
